title: os serve has no way to register trustedAppSchemes, so the mobile hand-off refuses every app
body:
Category: ① product defect with a named location and a reproduction.

Business reason: a deployment that wants Google sign-in in the mobile app has to register the app's scheme, and `os serve`, the documented way to run a server, has no setting for it. #29766 says the plugin "only mounts when `trustedAppSchemes` is configured", and nothing a deployment can set reaches that key, so the hand-off in 18.3.0 refuses every app.

Reader: `domain:server`, one PR on `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`. objectstack-ai/mobile#148 waits on it.

Duplicate search: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack trustedAppSchemes` (5 hits, all closed, the spec and server halves; none wires the CLI) and `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` (0 hits).

reach: measured on `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0`, 2026-11-03.

## Reproduction

```bash
grep -c trustedAppSchemes node_modules/@objectstack/cli/dist/commands/serve.js
```

Answers `0`. `serve.ts:4351` builds `new AuthPlugin({...})` and passes `trustedOrigins` but no `trustedAppSchemes`, and no environment variable reads into it. On that build, `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?redirect_uri=ai.objectos.mobile%3A%2F%2Fauth%2Fcallback&code_challenge=<43 chars>` answers `400 ... is not a registered app scheme`, whatever the operator sets. The same request answers `401` once the key is patched in by hand, which is what proves the key is the only thing missing. A stack can supply its own `AuthPlugin`, but it then gives up everything `serve.ts` wires.

## Ask

Give `os serve` a way to set the list, in the shape `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` already has: an `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` comma-separated variable passed as `trustedAppSchemes`, listed in `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`. A bad entry keeps failing loudly at construction (`assertTrustedAppSchemes`).

Unset stays unset: the hand-off is opt-in per deployment, and this card does not change that.

## Acceptance notes

- A contract test in the style of `serve-auth-*.contract.test.ts` that the value reaches `new AuthPlugin(`.
- Boot check: with the variable set the request above answers `401`, and with it unset `400`.

Out of scope, and the cloud lane's: the hosted runtime builds its own `AuthPlugin` (`cloud: packages/objectos-runtime/src/artifact-kernel-factory.ts:1097`), so hosted environments need their own wiring. That is tracked from objectstack-ai/mobile#148, not here.

Blocks: objectstack-ai/mobile#148
